race.comment: Looks a fair bit of pressure as some of the chances draw wide. TUXEDO MISS (6) is racing well and looks the play. Winner three back then has placed in two runs since, the latest winding up strongly to finish third at Geelong. Drawn for a good trail and expected to go close. CHOSEN VENTURE (5) returns from a break and looks a danger. Boasts a very strong fresh record and expected to be running into the finish. SUNDAY FUN DAY (3) has a tricky gate but has speed and another bold showing is expected. CHELSEA TOFF (7) has been thereabouts without threatening but is fitter for two runs back and looks ready to fire.
